title: Delegate and steer a bounded child
steps: Admit a role within the parent envelope; show concurrency and budget reservation.
Inspect the child's actual model, role and status.
Send a ≤500-character steer or use a supported model control.
Resolve a child-scoped approval in the approval dock.
Inspect the typed handoff. Child output is evidence, not automatic parent success.
forbidden_fake_states: stale controls acting on a new generation
complete_when: shared budget and ownership hold; a child saying done does not establish parent verification (p.185).
traceability: p.185; controls A-06..A-12, M-11, B-04, Q-06; acceptance A25, A26.
